text.en: Find the notes of line 1: each one waits until you're on it.
The pirates sing about creeping in silence, but Sullivan marks their chorus Allegro marziale, like a march, and it gets louder as it goes: the joke is in the music.

source.en: The Pirates of Penzance, vocal score (Chappell), Act II No. 12, read from the scan

Now lines 5 to 7 joined, with the guide.
Come, friends start to end, with the guide.
With cat-like tread start to end, with the guide.
The whole song, with the guide.
Sing your part with the other parts, and the guide with you. Hold your line while the others move.
The guide drops out: your part with the others only. Give me my note plays your first note quietly.
Once more on your own, from the top.
Record the tune of With Cat-like Tread in Sing, with the other parts playing.
Two choruses sing at once here: the pirates creep along "with cat-like tread" while the police answer "Tarantara!", each chorus in two parts.
